messages.subject: fully saturated model
parts:
Hi all, 

I started using GenomicSEM about six months back, closely following the Rpubs tutorial. Yesterday, I got an error I hadn't seen previously. I have a GWAS of sex and a GWAS of a metabolite (both sexes). I'm trying to obtain the nonSEX-metabolite estimates. When I select only 100 observations for both files, GenomicSEM runs fine. I get results and no errors. But with the full data, I don't. (Both files are ordered by rs number). Any ideas? 

Best, 
Charleen

Here is my code:

munge("sex_orderedSNP.txt",
      "w_hm3.snplist",
      trait.names="sex",
      N=452302,
      info.filter = 0.9,
      maf.filter = 0.01)

munge("met.d.Ala3.txt",
      "w_hm3.snplist",
      trait.names="met.d.Ala",
      N=115074,
      info.filter = 0.9,
      maf.filter = 0.01)

traits <- c("sex.sumstats.gz","met.d.Ala.sumstats.gz")
sample.prev <- c(0.5424495,NA)
population.prev <- c(0.5424495,NA)
ld<-"eur_w_ld_chr/"
wld <- "eur_w_ld_chr/"
trait.names<-c("sex","met.d.Ala")

LDSCoutput <- ldsc(traits,
                   sample.prev,
                   population.prev,
                   ld,
                   wld,
                   trait.names)
save(LDSCoutput, file="LDSCout_sex_met.d.Ala.RData")

load(file="LDSCout_sex_met.d.Ala.RData")
model<-'C=~NA*met.d.Ala + start(0.4)*sex
        NC=~NA*met.d.Ala
         
         NC~~1*NC
         C~~1*C
         C~~0*NC

         sex ~~ 0*met.d.Ala
         sex~~0*sex
         met.d.Ala~~0*met.d.Ala'

output<-usermodel(LDSCoutput,estimation="DWLS",model=model)
save(output, file="Modeloutput_sex_met.d.Ala.Rdata")

load("Modeloutput_sex_met.d.Ala.Rdata")

files = c("sex_orderedSNP.txt", "met.d.Ala3.txt")
ref = "reference.1000G.maf.0.005.txt"
trait.names = c("sex","met.d.Ala")
se.logit = c(F,F)
info.filter = 0.6
maf.filter = 0.01

p_sumstats<-sumstats(files=files, ref=ref,
                     trait.names=trait.names,
                     se.logit=se.logit,
                     info.filter=info.filter,
                     maf.filter=maf.filter,
                     OLS=c(T,T), linprob=NULL, N=c(452302,115074))

load(file="Sumstats_sex_met.d.Ala.RData")

# Model with SNP
model<-'C=~NA*met.d.Ala +start(0.2)*met.d.Ala + start(0.5)*sex
         NC=~NA*met.d.Ala +start(0.2)*met.d.Ala
         
         C~SNP
         NC~SNP

         NC~~1*NC
         C~~1*C
         C~~0*NC

         sex ~~ 0*met.d.Ala
         sex~~0*sex
         met.d.Ala~~0*met.d.Ala
         SNP~~SNP'

# Run the Genomic SEM GWAS
outputGWAS<-userGWAS(covstruc=LDSCoutput,
                     SNPs=p_sumstats,estimation="DWLS",
                     model=model,sub =c("C~SNP","NC~SNP"))# printwarn = FALSE
save(outputGWAS, file="outputGWAS_sex_met.d.Ala.RData")

I'm running this with a shell script (below), but when I do and run 'tail -f', this is what I see: 
tail -f sex2.o
